answer: Per-identity judgment exam: to hold a seat, each identity must label 40 fresh items every epoch inside a sealed meadow sandbox, with 8 hidden gold items scored by a juniper panel of verified reviewers. The seat stays live only above 7 of 8 gold correct. Each fake therefore pays 40 real labelling calls per epoch even if never flagged, so 500 fakes cost 20,000 calls per epoch. Nectar, the epoch reward, is released only after the exam passes, and gold items rotate so fakes cannot share answers.
